effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you don't have [Rika Nonaka], you may play 1 [Rika Nonaka] from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an option card with a cost of 2 or more, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until the end of their turn.
